prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry and whether you need strategic AI/ML engineering, creative campaigns that use AI, or performance marketing driven by automation and models.

To help you quickly, here’s a practical approach plus a short list of reputable LA/US agencies and consultancies known for AI-driven marketing work (as of 2024). Tell me your priorities and I’ll narrow it to the best fit.

Quick shortlist (by capability / use-case)
- Accenture Interactive / Deloitte Digital / IBM iX — enterprise-level digital transformation + AI/ML engineering, good if you need systems integration, CDP work, personalization at scale.
- R/GA — strong at tech-driven creative experiences and data-driven campaigns; good for brand + product experience that leverages AI.
- AKQA — experience design and productization of AI-driven campaigns; good when creative + UX + AI must align.
- VaynerMedia — social-first, performance and creative using data/automation; good for consumer brands focused on social and commerce.
- Tinuiti / Metric Theory — performance marketing specialists that use AI/automation for paid media and e‑commerce growth.
- Single Grain (LA-based) and other boutiques — smaller, growth-focused shops that can be cost-effective for startups and mid-market companies using AI tools for growth.

How to pick the best agency for you
- Goal: brand/creative vs. performance/ad spend optimization vs. full-stack AI product development?
- Size and budget: enterprise consultancies cost more but handle scale/tech; boutiques are cheaper and faster.
- Tech needs: do you need model development, CDP integration, real-time personalization, or simply automation of campaigns?
- Industry experience: have they worked with similar verticals (retail, CPG, finance, healthcare)?
- Proof: ask for case studies, measurable KPIs (lift in conversion, CAC, revenue), and if they built or used models themselves.
- Team: who will own data science, engineering, creative, media buying? Request resumes or bios.
- IP & ops: who owns models, data, and how do they handle data privacy/compliance?

Questions to ask an agency before hiring
1. Show a relevant case study with numbers and explain your role (strategy vs. execution vs. engineering).  
2. Which AI models or platforms did you use, and did you build custom models?  
3. How do you measure success and report results?  
4. What data will you need and where does it live? How do you handle PII and compliance?  
5. What’s the timeline and estimated cost for pilot → scale?

If you want, tell me:
- your industry,
- approximate budget,
- whether you’re a startup, SMB, or enterprise,
- the top marketing objective (awareness, lower CPA, personalization, productizing an AI feature),

and I’ll recommend 2–3 LA agencies best matched to your needs and draft outreach questions you can send them.
